name: api_base_url
label: Payments API base URL
help_text: ATRI Platform address, with no trailing slash. Use a staging URL while testing.

name: public_key
label: Platform public key
help_text: From the platform admin: Accounts > Public keys. Starts with pk_. Its allowed origins must include this site's domain. Never paste any other key here; the Stripe key comes from the platform automatically.

name: fee_percent
label: Cover-fees percentage
help_text: Offers buyers the option to add this % (of items + gifts) as an extra donation to help cover processing fees. Set to 0 to hide the option.

name: gift_sku
label: Give to ATRI gift SKU
help_text: Sent to Stripe (metadata "skus") with one-time gifts from this section, e.g. "ATRI-GIVE $50.00". Gifts from the Audio Bibles section use that section's custom gift SKU instead. Letters, numbers, dot, dash and underscore only.

name: offer_monthly
label: Offer monthly gifts
help_text: Shows the Monthly tab. Monthly gifts renew in WooCommerce under the subscription products ICF-30, ICF-100, ICF-500, ICF-1000 and ICF-Custom (any other amount); those SKUs must exist and be published.

name: legacy_giving_url
label: Legacy giving page
help_text: Where the Legacy Giving tab sends visitors. Leave empty to hide the tab.

children.name: enabled
children.label: Show product suggestions once the cart has items

children.name: products_url
children.label: Products endpoint
children.help_text: ATRI Store API products endpoint. page_size=200 returns the whole catalog in one request.

children.name: featured_skus
children.label: Featured SKUs (comma-separated)
children.help_text: Shown first, in this order. After these, products that share a topic with the cart are suggested.

children.name: per_row
children.label: Cards per row
children.help_text: A second row is added when the cart has 4 or more items (it grows taller).
